title: LEAP-LLM: Preserving lead-time structure for question-conditioned ECG interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18809v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The electrocardiogram (ECG) records cardiac electrical activity across multiple leads and is used for detecting cardiac abnormalities. Recent ECG-language models enable large language models (LLMs) to interpret cardiac signals and answer clinically relevant questions. However, existing ECG-language models typically encode the ECG independently of the clinical question, forcing the ECG representation to retain broad and potentially irrelevant signal information. Moreover, these models often aggregate information across leads which can obscure lead-specific details needed for a particular question. To tackle these limitations, we introduce LEAP-LLM, an ECG-LLM architecture for Lead-aware ECG Alignment with Prompt conditioning. LEAP-LLM uses the clinical question to guide ECG feature extraction while preserving explicit lead and temporal structure. translated_title: LEAP-LLM：为问题条件化的心电图解读保留导联-时间结构
translated_abstract: 心电图（ECG）记录了多个导联的心脏电活动，被用于检测心脏异常。近来的心电图-语言模型使大型语言模型（LLM）能够解读心电信号并回答临床相关问题。然而，现有的心电图-语言模型通常在与临床问题无关的情况下独立编码心电图，迫使心电图表征保留宽泛且可能无关的信号信息。此外，这些模型往往跨导联聚合信息，这可能掩盖回答特定问题所需的导联特异性细节。为解决这些局限，我们提出了LEAP-LLM，一种面向导联感知心电图对齐与提示条件化（Lead-aware ECG Alignment with Prompt conditioning）的心电图-大语言模型架构。LEAP-LLM利用临床问题来引导心电图特征提取，同时保留显式的导联与时间结构。经过任务训练的指令表示从问题中提炼信息，并引导……
tldr: 提出LEAP-LLM架构，利用临床问题引导心电图特征提取并保留显式的导联与时间结构，从而克服现有模型编码与问题无关信息、跨导联聚合掩盖导联细节的缺陷，提升问题条件化的心电图解读能力。
en_tdlr: LEAP-LLM is an ECG-LLM architecture that conditions ECG feature extraction on the clinical question while preserving explicit lead and temporal structure, overcoming irrelevant signal encoding and lead information aggregation to improve question-conditioned ECG interpretation.
